title: The Faithful Lantern
author: Edmund Halloran
blurb: Ulyana Pemberton, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, has spent twelve years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
